create.name: John Lockley
create.bio:
John Lockley is a South African sangoma, a traditional healer and teacher, initiated and ordained in the Xhosa and Swazi traditions. Called by a dream while serving as a conscripted army medic in 1990, he went on to complete a ten-year apprenticeship with a Xhosa elder at a time when it was rare for a white South African to be accepted into the lineage, and was later given the title of senior sangoma by Xhosa elders. He also holds an honours degree in clinical psychology and has practised Zen meditation for more than thirty years.

His teaching centres on Ubuntu, ancestral connection, dream tracking, nature spirits and ceremony, and he often bridges this indigenous worldview with Western psychology. His book Leopard Warrior (Sounds True, 2017) tells the story of his training, and his audio programme The Way of the Leopard sets out meditations and shamanic practices. He leads monthly online ceremonies, workshops in London, Dublin and Geneva, courses with the College of Psychic Studies and The Shift Network, and Dreams & Tracking retreats in Botswana's Kalahari Desert.

books.title: Leopard Warrior: A Journey into the African Teachings of Ancestry, Instinct, and Dreams
books.author: John Lockley
books.description: A teaching memoir of John Lockley's path from a dream he had as a young army medic in 1990 to his long apprenticeship as a Xhosa sangoma. It shares the teachings he received on ancestors, instinct and dreams, and what it meant to cross South Africa's divides of race and culture.

courses.title: South African Shamanic Wisdom
courses.description: A self-paced seven-module course in South African shamanic practice and the spirit of Ubuntu, using ceremony, drumming, chant, trance dance and dreamwork. Participants work with their ancestral lineage and build an ancestral earth shrine.

courses.title: African Shamanic Dreamwork
courses.description: A self-paced seven-module course on dream interpretation, dream tracking and ritual from the Xhosa and Swazi traditions. It focuses on understanding the messages in dreams and connecting with the ancestors and your life's purpose.

courses.title: Shamanic Teachings of Southern Africa: Dreams, Ancestors & Nature Spirits (College of Psychic Studies)
courses.description: A six-week live online course on Wednesday evenings (UK time) hosted by the College of Psychic Studies in London. It covers connecting with ancestors and spirit guides, dream tracking, shadow work and altar building, household plants in ritual and the water spirits.

courses.title: Dreams & Tracking Retreat in the Kalahari Desert 2027
courses.description: A small-group retreat in Botswana's Kalahari Desert led with tracker Alwyn Myburgh and San elders, combining dream tracking, ancestral ceremony and animal tracking on foot. Two nine-night dates are offered (14-22 February and 28 February-8 March 2027), each with an optional Okavango Delta extension.

courses.title: Monthly Ceremonies with John Lockley
courses.description: A monthly online ceremony with a talk, guided meditation, chanting and an invocation in isiXhosa, followed by questions on dreams, ancestors and spiritual practice. Recordings are sent to all members.

courses.title: Connect to your bones (3 hour teaching)
courses.description: A recorded three-hour teaching on the fundamentals of indigenous ancestral practice from South Africa. It introduces the importance of the ancestors in this tradition through teaching and practice.

courses.title: Navigating Altered States (Series of 3 webinars)
courses.description: Three recorded webinars on how shamans and mystics in different cultures have used trance and altered states to connect with spirit. Includes teaching and guided practice.

courses.title: Exploring Meditation (Series of 3 webinars)
courses.description: Three recorded webinars on developing a personal meditation practice amid the busyness of everyday life.

courses.title: The Art of Prayer, the Mystic's Way
courses.description: A recorded 33-minute teaching on prayer as a mystical practice, with a 17-minute bonus track.

courses.title: Guided Meditation to connect to your Soul
courses.description: A guided meditation using breath, stillness, singing and drumming to deepen connection with your soul.

free_resources.title: John Lockley's Guided Meditations (SoundCloud)
free_resources.description: A free collection of guided meditations by John Lockley, shared on his SoundCloud and linked from his website's meditation library.

flags: The Kalahari retreat is co-led with tracker Alwyn Myburgh; price is only given on request by email (info@johnlockley.com). The date range given covers both retreat dates including optional extensions.
The College of Psychic Studies course price is £200 GBP (members save £30).
The SoundCloud meditation set was linked from his site but the set contents were not opened individually.
Bio says 'senior sangoma' for the Xhosa title Ligqira Linkulu, as given on his Shift profile.
left_out: Shift 'Ancestral Dream Healing' (subtitle: 'transform trauma in yourself & your lineages'): trauma in the subtitle.
The Way of the Leopard: Meditations & Shamanic Practices (Amazon 1683640349 / audiobook B076BV8VWN): an audio programme, not a book; the Amazon page could not be read to confirm format.

Gumroad recordings not listed (cap of 10 offerings): The Gift of Calling, Find your Medicine, Making Magic, Expanding consciousness through connecting with ether, The Rise of the Goddess series; also 'Medicinal Plants for Healing & Dreaming' (healing-plant framing, borderline).
One-to-one Zoom sessions ($250 USD), mentoring ($1,495 USD) and bone-throwing divinations ($335 USD): one-to-one is not his main way of working.
Past events: European tour (London 8 Oct, Dublin 17 Oct, Geneva 24-25 Oct 2026) and the Plant Spirit Medicine webinar series (Aug-Sep 2026).

Videos: clips under ~2 minutes, promotional and info-webinar videos (Leopard Warrior Trails 2024, Free Shamanic Wisdom Summit, course trailers, session adverts), seasonal greetings (Christmas Blessing, New Year message), and Shift Network channel videos.
